description: Implement PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id} to edit the status comment in place as the run progresses. Status transitions: running → completed (with branch/PR link), failed (with retry instructions), interrupted (on restart recovery), aborted (on duplicate claim). Never post a new comment — always edit the existing one. Failure messages must not include raw agent output, file paths, tokens, or anything that could leak secrets.
title: Status comment lifecycle updates (running → completed/failed/interrupted)
